spans.s:
Tithi, as the name of a lunar day, the thirtieth part of a lunar month of rather over twenty-seven days, is only found in the later Sūtras, being completely unknown to the Brāhmaṇas, in which the only day is the natural one. See māsa.
Foot notes Gobhila gṛhya sūtra, i. 1, 13; ii. 8, 12, 20; śāṅkhāyana gṛhya sūtra, i. 25; v. 2, etc.
Thibaut, Astronomie, Astrologie und Mathematik, 7, 8.
